high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "wintourworld." The post features a photograph taken on March 11, 2022, in London, England. The photo captures a woman walking down a street, dressed in a striking blue coat adorned with a pattern of white horse heads and gold geometric designs. She is wearing sunglasses and appears to be adjusting them with her right hand. Her hair is styled in a short, blonde bob. The woman is being assisted by two individuals on either side of her. On her left, there is a person in a black suit with a white shirt and tie
